item.title: Organizers cite costs in permanent discontinuance of McIntosh 1890s Festival
item.description: The McIntosh 1890s Festival, a long-standing annual tradition in northern Marion County, has been permanently discontinued due to unsustainably high operating costs and dwindling community interest.
